card.statement:
We construct certain boson type realizations of affine $\mathfrak{sl}(n+1)$ that depend on a parameter $0\leq
r\leq n$ such that when $r=0$ we get a Fock space realization appearing in the work of the first author and when $r=n$ they are the Wakimoto modules described in the work of Feigin and Frenkel.
card.label: Abstract

paper.title: Intermediate Wakimoto modules for Affine sl(n+1)
paper.abstract: We construct certain boson type realizations of affine sl(n+1) that depend on a parameter r. When r=0 we get a Fock space realization of Imaginary Verma modules appearing in the work of the first author and when r=n they are the Wakimoto modules described in the work of Feigin and Frenkel.
